gates.command: sh -c 'for g in docs/dagpipe/*.graph.json; do dagpipe graph validate "$g" || exit 1; done'
gates.human_contract: Every weibo flow graph and the computeruse branch graph must pass dagpipe static validate (SESE, acyclic, deterministic waves). This is the pre-execution gate; dagpipe does not execute, PageDagRuntime/camo runtime owns execution.

owners.json is the single source of truth; every graph node maps to a real code owner with exact file+line+symbol, and the contract test asserts the symbol is on that line. Catches drift a hardcoded expectation cannot.

gates.command: sh -c 'test -f apps/webauto/resources/container-library.index.json && node -e "const i=require("./apps/webauto/resources/container-library.index.json"); const keys=Object.keys(i); if(!keys.length)throw new Error("no sites"); for(const k of keys){if(!i[k].website)throw new Error(k+" missing website")}"'
gates.human_contract: Container library is organized by root domain (site key -> website); different sites are physically isolated in separate directories. This is the framework's isolation invariant.
webauto governance regression suite: dagpipe graph contracts + owner drift detection. Minimum 6 tests (one per graph-shape assertion).
